title: [bundle] Fix prompt_hub/intake bundle artifact residency: non-task Sw
objective: Fix prompt_hub/intake bundle artifact residency: non-task SwarmBundle JSON files must not be written under .handoff/tasks because card loading treats every JSON there as a task card and emits schema warnings. Move bundles to a non-card inbox path, update intake default path/docs/tests, and ensure prompt_hub still mints tasks without polluting the task-card directory.
acceptance_criteria: hf prompt-hub writes SwarmBundle artifacts outside `.handoff/tasks/` so task-card loading never sees non-card bundle JSON.
handoff-intake default bundle path is also outside `.handoff/tasks/` and aligned with the prompt-hub bundle inbox.
Tests assert bundle paths use the non-card inbox and do not use tasks_dir.
Drift audit passes and TASK-F57ABB-0001 has green witnessed test evidence.
